G8_retraction_semantics.threshold: (amendment A4) a certificate bit is observed when its channel is unmasked at the certificate step. Every retraction reason equals the evaluator truth: falsified_by_observation iff some unmasked bit contradicts the certified code; scope_withdrawn iff both bits are unmasked and agree with it; unverifiable_masked otherwise. The count of falsified_by_observation equals the count of retracted wrong certificates with a contradicting unmasked bit. Wrong certificates in cases that are never contradicted are counted and reported.

G9_compute_budget.threshold: peak rows <= 160000 for both learners; every budget exhaustion yields ABSTAIN/BUDGET_EXHAUSTED; no budget exhaustion in a case where the v0.1.0_control arm had none
G9_compute_budget.reported: peak rows per family (study-002 peak margin rows 99818), total wall-clock (target <= 2x v0.1.0_control arm)
